title: Add Hunt Planning feature design document
body:
Adds `hunt_planning_design.txt` at repo root — a full architecture design for a new Hunt Planning feature derived from a deep-dive analysis of the existing codebase.

## Covers

- **Repo overview** — confirmed stack (FastAPI + SQLAlchemy async + PostGIS, React + Leaflet + TanStack Query, Supabase JWT, Google Drive storage), all existing ORM models and API routers with file/line citations
- **Feature inventory** — map layers, hunt logging, groups/events, social feed, badges, notifications, land-access, admin submission review
- **Integration surface** — `GroupEvent` identified as the closest structural ancestor; `Notification` (generic `type`+`ref_id`) and `Post.group_id` patterns directly reusable with no schema changes
- **Data model** — three new tables: `hunt_plans` (point + optional GeoJSON polygon, status enum draft/scheduled/completed/cancelled, JSONB weather snapshot/gear checklist/target species), `hunt_plan_members` (party invite/accept/decline), `hunt_plan_stands` (named positions with assignee)
- **API surface** — full CRUD + status transitions, party management, stand management, weather snapshot refresh, map-pins projection, and a `POST /convert` endpoint that materializes a plan into a `UserPin`
- **UI screens** — `MyPlansPage` (tabbed list + calendar), `CreatePlanPage` (7-step wizard with embedded map picker), `PlanDetailPage` (split panel: metadata/checklist + map overlay with polygon, stands, wind arrow, historical sightings filter)
- **Phased roadmap** — Phase 1 MVP (model + CRUD + basic pages), Phase 2 (map overlays, party sharing, weather/moon/sunrise service), Phase 3 (APScheduler reminders, calendar view, plan→hunt conversion); every affected file listed by path and phase
